q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution

Q2 FY2027 ends July 26, 2026 — this date is already in the past (today is August 22, 2026). NVIDIA would announce earnings and provide forward guidance for Q3 FY2027 at their Q2 earnings call, which typically occurs 3–4 weeks after quarter end. The Q2 FY2027 earnings release has almost certainly already occurred or is imminent (late August 2026). Resolution is essentially immediate or already resolved.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

**The question asks for forward guidance (not actual Q2 results), and the research explicitly states that guidance has already been announced.**

According to the current research dated May 20, 2026:
- NVIDIA announced Q2 FY2027 forward revenue guidance of **$91.0 billion ± 2%**
- This translates to a range of **$89.2 billion to $92.8 billion**
- Wall Street consensus (Yahoo! Finance) sits at $91.9 billion, within the guided range

The guidance is already public and known. Unless the company revises guidance between announcement and actual earnings release (uncommon), the forward guidance figure for Q2 FY2027 is locked at $91.0 billion.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- A negative revision to guidance before the earnings release (rare; would signal major operational problems)
- Misinterpretation of the guidance figure (e.g., confusing it with actual results or a different quarter)
- Exceptional macro deterioration requiring mid-quarter correction

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- A positive pre-earnings revision (possible but uncommon absent major positive surprise)
- Accelerating demand for AI chips beyond expectations
- Improvement in China revenue or other factors enabling upward adjustment

However, given that we are already past May 2026 and in late August 2026, any revision would likely have already been communicated.

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The research provides the actual forward guidance figure: **$91.0 billion ± 2%**, announced May 20, 2026. This is not a historical base rate but rather the actual guidance already issued and still in effect.

---

## Reasoning

The question is asking for NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release. The research confirms this guidance has already been provided: **$91.0 billion with a ±2% range ($89.2B–$92.8B).**

Since the guidance has already been announced and we are in late August 2026 (after the Q2 end date of July 26, 2026), the earnings release and guidance are either just released or about to be released. The figure is essentially known and will not change materially unless NVIDIA issues a rare pre-release revision.

The most likely outcome is that the earnings release will confirm or reiterate the **$91.0 billion guidance** announced in May.

For the distribution:
- **Median (50th percentile):** $91.0 billion (the announced guidance)
- **Low (10th percentile):** $89.2 billion (lower bound of ±2% range; possible if company revises downward, though unlikely)
- **High (90th percentile):** $92.8 billion (upper bound of ±2% range; possible if they revise upward slightly)

The range given (99.5–115.5B) is significantly higher than the actual guidance, suggesting this is designed to test whether forecasters can identify and use the forward guidance figure that has already been publicly announced.

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA has already provided forward guidance for its second quarter of fiscal year 2027 (ending July 26, 2026). On May 20, 2026, NVIDIA announced an outlook for Q2 FY2027 revenue of $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%. This means the company's projected range is between approximately $89.2 billion and $92.8 billion [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/) [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm).

This guidance does not include any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/) [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). Wall Street analysts, according to Yahoo! Finance, have an average estimate of $91.9 billion, which falls within NVIDIA's guided range [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). For comparison, NVIDIA reported $81.6 billion in revenue for Q1 FY2027, an 85% increase year-over-year [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/) [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm).
